name: scroll-restore-off-by-rows
observable: identity of the list item at the remembered viewport offset after backing out (not the pixel offset, which legitimately differs between engines)
template:
const delta = off() - snap.anchorOffset; // canary
      const _off = {magnitude} * 68; owner.scrollTop += _off;
anchor_note: Re-anchored 2026-10-19. The original anchored on the old pixel-only restore line, which U8 replaced when the restore became anchor-based. A drifted anchor patches nothing, so the canary would have been a clean build and a lane could have been credentialed on a detection that never happened. Now it perturbs the anchored placement itself, which is the thing that can actually lose the user their place.
